# volcano_project (Resource)

A Volcano project: the top-level container for databases, functions, frontends, storage, and auth configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_project" "example" {
  name = "my-awesome-app"
}

resource "volcano_project" "pinned_regions" {
  name             = "eu-only-app"
  all_regions      = false
  selected_regions = ["eu-west-1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name. Must be unique on the account and may only contain letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.

### Optional

- `all_regions` (Boolean) If true (default), project functions deploy to every configured platform region. If false, only to `selected_regions`.
- `initial_prompt` (String) Initial builder prompt used on creation. Cannot be combined with `template_id`. Forces replacement if changed.
- `selected_regions` (List of String) Region subset to deploy to when `all_regions` is false.
- `template_id` (String) Starter template to install on creation (`pixel-board`, `trellini`, `collab-pad`, or `official-starter`). Cannot be combined with `initial_prompt`. Forces replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Project UUID.
- `logo_url` (String) Relative API path serving the project logo, when one has been uploaded.
- `plan` (String) Billing plan applied to the project, when available.
- `status` (String) Project status (`active`, `deleting`, or `failed`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_project.example <project-id>
```
